title: Yellow Fragrant Thai Chicken Khao Pad
description: A floral and refreshing Thai dish featuring dried mint and pickle, perfect for a sick day. This khao pad is a dash-friendly and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned and cooked through.
Add the dried mint, pickle, fish sauce, and soy sauce, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked jasmine rice to the skillet or wok and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is heated through and starting to brown.
Serve the khao pad hot, garnished with additional dried mint if desired.
